producer: StagedGlobalAssembly.compile k n L hL binds StagedNormalizedCanonical.compile once, collect-materializes all n+1 actual StagedStagePrimitive.compileAt returns from that cached chain, recursively lifts/places/appends their actual lists, then performs the public wire relabeling.
signature: theorem compile_certified (k n : Nat) (L : Real) (hL : 0 < L) : let result := compile k n L hL; result.run.value.gateCount = (n+1)*localGates (HermiteFiniteChain.bondQubits k) AND result.run.value.resource.depth <= (n+1)*localGates (HermiteFiniteChain.bondQubits k) AND result.run.value.resource.oracleCalls = 0 AND evalPrimitiveCircuit result.run.value in Matrix.unitaryGroup (PrimitiveBasis ((n+1)+HermiteFiniteChain.bondQubits k)) Complex AND StoredHermiteRawCost.ordinary result.run.cost <= compilerBudget k n AND (forall x b, evalPrimitiveCircuit result.run.value (Fin.append x b) (fun _ => 0) = if b = (fun _ => 0) then HermiteStatePreparation.normalizedAmplitude k (n+1) L (primitiveBasisLEEquiv (n+1) x) else 0)

resource_model: Inherited exact-real scalar/index-word Run model. Ordinary includes sqrt/angle/trig/comparison/read/write/emit. Padding traverses the entire list once per added wire. Eight fixed index-word allowances are the declared placement instruction model, not bit complexity or generic free source callback evaluation.
